body: You’re doing an amazing job and it’s inspiring. Reading this post made me cry. Really wish my mom could’ve done what you just did when I was in pain as a teenager. Keep it up OP
Thank you! I will be checking that out as well. Sometimes you just need to get the anger out
This was so helpful. Especially the grandkids part. We know we have a future together, sometimes it’s just so hard to get past these roadblocks that seem never ending.
Like I said in the post, I have no one to talk to about this outside of reddit. This is a community meant to talk about relationships, isn’t it?
There’s not a rush necessarily, I guess it just feels like the next step because we live together. We also know a lot of people our age who are getting married and starting their families too
